verdict.tagline: Chaotic mini-golf marred by erratic physics and connection drops.
for_you_if: you play primarily with local groups
you enjoy custom workshop levels despite quirks
you can laugh off unpredictable physics engines
not_for_you_if: you require stable online multiplayer connections
you expect consistent and predictable ball physics
you play where disconnects ruin a session

claims.claim: The game lacks a reconnection feature for players who leave or disconnect during a session.

citations.review_text:
Fun minigolf-type game where you don't have to take turns.

Rating: 9.3/10

Golf With Your Friends is one of the most entertaining party games on Steam, turning a simple game of mini golf into a chaotic and highly competitive multiplayer experience. With support for up to 12 players, dozens of creative courses, fun power-ups, and a built-in level editor, it's the perfect game for relaxing with friends—or ruining friendships over a single missed putt.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the physics feel inconsistent with unpredictable ball movement and shots yielding different results under similar conditions.

citations.review_text: too much glitches on the maps, sometimes you hit a micropixel and it goes in an unexpected angle, other times you get stuck because the map was poorly designed. Don't buy it, waste of money. You'll rage more than have fun.

The ball flies like a ♥♥♥♥♥ (inconsistent results with near identical shots and generally unpredictable), major issues with desync in multiplier and a third of the base game maps are abysmal. Baring the fun aspect of coop with friends the game is simply annoying,
The game's physics are not consistent and imaginary walls appear in flat and curved spaces. It is infuriating and makes a fun time with friends unenjoyable.

It's *barely* golfing, but yes, your friends are here.

Pros:
- Rarely, if ever, run into server problems
- Decent amount of hours you can get out of playing
- Thoughtfully integrated game rules 
- Workshop integration
- Almost constantly on sale

Cons:
- The DLC is far too expensive to buy when not on sale
- DLC is required to 100% the game (if you're into that sort of thing)
- The physics can sometimes feel wildly different course to course, hole to hole, shot to shot
- Gameplay loop gets repetitive after that 3rd or 4th group you play with

It's literally Golf With Your Friends. 
Buying or being gifted this game just to be locked into a 4 hour long golf session is basically a rite of passage.

(Just wait for a sale if you want the responsibility of being the friend who hosts every time because you have the DLC.)
